page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance belonging to the ecs.r5 instance family. Virtualized using KVM, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system contains 512.0 GB of memory, yielding a resource ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This high RAM density targets execution requirements for memory-bound enterprise applications.

The hardware profile contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage to maintain persistent data. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and includes no dedicated GPU accelerators. The high allocation of memory per core allows efficient horizontal scaling for memory-intensive architectures without paying for unneeded CPU scale. Primary workload fits include enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale data analytics engines, distributed caching platforms, and resource-heavy enterprise planning systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance in the ecs.r5 server family. This configuration maintains an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio, making it structured for large memory requirements. Virtualized using KVM, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The substantial memory footprint offers cost efficiency by consolidating memory-bound applications onto fewer physical nodes. The instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads, including large enterprise in-memory databases, distributed caching systems, real-time data processing engines, and resource-heavy enterprise software applications.
